svg.aria-label: Community: Qwen Ambassador. Started Qwen Pakistan from scratch. 3,000+ followers and 250K+ impressions in the first week, then the AI Buildathon 2026. Host, RevenueCat Shipaton IRL. The first in-person Shipaton in Pakistan. 43 signed up. Replit Campus Leader. Before that, Notion Campus Leader for a year. Dev Weekends. Internal operations, fellowships, mentorship, and a weekly cohort of 40 engineers.
